earnings_calls.transcript: Management: We are pleased to report our strongest-ever order backlog, driven by the energy transition, grid modernisation and rising renewables integration. Demand across HVDC, transformers and grid automation remains robust and we expect this momentum to continue into the coming year. Margins improved on better project execution and easing supply-chain pressures, and we are confident of sustaining double-digit growth. We remain focused on localisation and capacity expansion. On the analyst question regarding competition, we believe our technology leadership and installed base give us a durable advantage. We are cautiously optimistic on pricing discipline in the industry.
